text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is the second race
of the
Classic Triple Crown. Rumor has it
that the other
racers there are
intimidated by Нарита Брайан...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I feel a little uneasy about such unsavory
rumors,
but Нарита Брайан brushes them
off as nothing more
than white noise.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Each one of the racers in her year is
serious about
victory. The thought
pleases Нарита Брайан, setting
her fighting
spirit alight.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
